arxiv:2610.15314v1.unproven: evaluation limited to instructed honest/deceptive statements on one benchmark; generalization to real-world deception contexts undemonstrated; false-positive rates and confidence thresholds not reported for adversarial or out-of-distribution deception.

arxiv:2610.15390v1.title: From Acoustic Sensing to Physical Actions: A Comprehensive Survey of Security Risks in Edge-Deployed Audio LLM-Based Agents
arxiv:2610.15390v1.dek: Survey of Audio LLM agents in edge devices identifies security gaps at transitions between acoustic sensing, agent logic, and physical execution stages.
arxiv:2610.15390v1.unproven: synthesizes attacks and defenses from existing literature without new empirical measurements; does not demonstrate which defense combinations close identified gaps in real deployed agents.

arxiv:2610.15396v1.title: Training-Data Extraction from Genomic Language Models
arxiv:2610.15396v1.dek: Output-only black-box attack recovers 22 training segments (500+ bp) from Evo 2 genomic model at 9.57% cluster-level success rate.
arxiv:2610.15396v1.unproven: evaluation limited to one model family and two sequence prefixes (bacteriophage, plasmid); attack success criteria (convergence without gradient access) not validated on models with different training or architecture; relevance to production genomic workflows unclear.

arxiv:2610.15482v1.title: Security in LLM-Assisted Coding: A Systematic Literature Review
arxiv:2610.15482v1.dek: Systematic review confirms LLM-generated code carries training-data biases and faulty patches; human oversight remains necessary despite automation.
arxiv:2610.15482v1.unproven: literature review without new empirical data; does not quantify which code-generation scenarios remain unsafe after human review or establish which oversight practices prevent residual risk.

arxiv:2610.15502v1.title: From Observations to Authorized Actions: Measuring Source Information in Android Agents
arxiv:2610.15502v1.dek: Android WebView accessibility interface omits document origins, preventing agents from checking content source; source-reference gate demonstrated on 24-trial WebView evaluation.

arxiv:2610.15537v1.title: Poisoned into Action: Context Attacks on Typed Decision Workflows
arxiv:2610.15537v1.dek: Context poisoning on typed decision workflows produces security violations through schema-valid choices in synthetic two-workflow test.
arxiv:2610.15537v1.unproven: evaluation limited to two synthetic workflows and one model family; execution-aware tracing protocol not validated against real deployed agents; defense tuning parameters (empty-scope gate) appear dataset-specific.

arxiv:2610.15541v1.title: Fetch Me If You Can: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fetch Metadata
arxiv:2610.15541v1.dek: First large-scale measurement of Fetch Metadata adoption across 1M websites reveals gaps against cross-site threats.
arxiv:2610.15541v1.unproven: does not establish that adoption correlates with actual reduction in cross-site incidents; custom policies measured in the wild, not validated for soundness.

arxiv:2610.15626v1.title: Riemannian Suppression of Cross-Session Identity Leakage in Motor-Imagery EEG
arxiv:2610.15626v1.dek: EEG identity leakage reduced via Riemannian covariance transformation on motor-imagery data.
arxiv:2610.15626v1.unproven: scope limited to two public BCI datasets; applicability to production medical or security deployments undemonstrated; assumes EEG remains the leakage vector under different capture or adversarial conditions.

arxiv:2610.15628v1.title: Robust Detection of Directional Adversarial Attacks in Deep Neural Networks for Radiological Imaging
arxiv:2610.15628v1.dek: Detection framework distinguishes adversarial perturbations on medical imaging via Sigmoid function variance analysis and random-noise probing.

arxiv:2610.15725v1.title: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
arxiv:2610.15725v1.dek: SkillMarker embeds watermarks in agent skill instructions for ownership verification and leakage tracing while preserving functionality.

arxiv:2610.15729v1.title: LLM-based Code Auditing by Inferring and Evaluating Developer Assumptions
arxiv:2610.15729v1.dek: Creed infers developer security assumptions (e.g., from null checks) to detect semantic flaws like timing side channels that syntax-based SAST tools miss.

arxiv:2610.15804v1.dek: Privacy Conductor gates LLM document retrieval with deterministic policy enforcement; LLM-labeled documents degrade access-control recall to 23%, creating audit liability.

arxiv:2610.15872v1.dek: GNG-OTA framework applies generative AI and graph neural networks to O-RAN testing and interoperability automation.

arxiv:2610.15902v1.dek: U-Net with OCR-guided loss recovers text from degraded Word document thumbnails in forensic analysis.
